selection: last epoch fixed; held machine never used for stopping
score: mean four patch logits per recording
input: four separate 32-column patches at 64 ms stride; each spans 2.096 s of raw waveform, adjacent supports overlap 48 ms; total support 8.24 s; 128 uniform bands; frequency position retained
augmentation: uniform [-1,1] times difference of source fit-normal mean frequency profiles; independent of class
